# Hyperstac

## Reusable assets

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `asset_folder` | `str` | `hyperstac` | `basic` | Project-relative folder for reusable HyPERSTAC images, patches, models, and AnnData assets. | Keep this outside general.outputs_folder because downstream stages reuse these files. |
| `input_images_folder` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional ROI/channel TIFF folder; null uses general.denoised_images_folder. | Each ROI must be a subfolder containing consistently named channel TIFF files. |
| `overwrite` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Replace existing HyPERSTAC model assets for a deliberate rerun. | - |

## Images

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channels` | `List[str]` | `[]` | `basic` | Ordered channel names; an empty list infers and validates the common alphabetical channel set. | The former GBM-specific marker list is intentionally not a package default. |
| `preprocess_images` | `bool` | `True` | `basic` | Create normalized channel TIFF assets before modelling. | - |

## Image normalization

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `background_subtraction` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Subtract a fixed or percentile background estimate before scaling. | - |
| `background_method` | `Literal['fixed', 'percentile']` | `fixed` | `advanced` | Background estimator used for every ROI/channel image. | - |
| `background_fixed_value` | `float` | `0.5` | `advanced` | Fixed background value subtracted when background_method is fixed. | - |
| `background_percentile` | `float` | `20.0` | `advanced` | Per-image percentile used when background_method is percentile. | - |
| `presence_mask` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Restrict scale estimation to pixels passing a per-image presence threshold. | Disabled by default to preserve the tested IMC adaptation. |
| `presence_percentile` | `float` | `95.0` | `advanced` | Percentile used to derive a channel-presence score. | - |
| `presence_threshold` | `float` | `1.0` | `advanced` | Minimum presence score when presence masking is enabled. | - |
| `scale_percentile` | `float` | `99.5` | `advanced` | Robust per-channel percentile mapped to one after background correction. | - |
| `scale_present_only` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Estimate scale only from presence-positive pixels. | - |
| `scale_sample_pixels` | `int` | `0` | `advanced` | Maximum pixels sampled per ROI/channel for scale estimation; zero uses all pixels. | - |
| `tiff_compression` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional tifffile compression codec for normalized TIFF assets. | - |
| `preprocess_overwrite` | `bool` | `True` | `advanced` | Replace existing normalized TIFF outputs after validating the target path. | - |

## Patches

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `patch_size` | `int` | `100` | `basic` | Square patch size in pixels. | At 1 um/pixel this represents a 100 um tissue window; the preprint used 224 px mIF tiles. |
| `stride` | `Optional[int]` | `null` | `advanced` | Patch stride in pixels; null uses patch_size for non-overlapping patches. | - |
| `pixel_size_um` | `float` | `1.0` | `basic` | Micrometres represented by one source-image pixel. | - |
| `mask_channel` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional marker channel used for a direct tissue/background patch filter. | - |
| `mask_threshold` | `float` | `0.05` | `advanced` | Mask-channel value above which a pixel is treated as tissue. | - |
| `min_mask_fraction` | `float` | `0.05` | `advanced` | Minimum mask-positive pixel fraction required for a patch. | - |
| `min_patch_signal` | `float` | `0.0` | `advanced` | Minimum whole-patch mean signal; zero disables this filter. | - |
| `subpatch_size` | `int` | `10` | `advanced` | Square local subpatch size used by the channel-independent tissue filter. | - |
| `subpatch_signal_threshold` | `float` | `0.01` | `advanced` | Mean all-channel signal required for a local subpatch to count as tissue. | - |
| `min_tissue_subpatch_fraction` | `float` | `0.5` | `advanced` | Minimum fraction of tissue-positive local subpatches required to retain a patch. | - |
| `reuse_patches` | `bool` | `False` | `advanced` | Reuse an existing validated patch set instead of re-tiling. | - |

## VICReg training

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `encoder` | `Literal['resnet50', 'small-cnn']` | `resnet50` | `basic` | Image encoder architecture. | - |
| `encoder_weights` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional existing encoder weights; when set, VICReg training is skipped. | - |
| `epochs` | `int` | `50` | `basic` | VICReg training epochs for the tested IMC adaptation. | The published mIF protocol used 100 epochs; increase after dataset-specific convergence review. |
| `batch_size` | `int` | `64` | `advanced` | VICReg training batch size. | The preprint used 256 on an 80 GB H100; 64 is the safer portable IMC default. |
| `representation_batch_size` | `Optional[int]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional embedding-extraction batch size; null reuses batch_size. | - |
| `learning_rate` | `float` | `0.0001` | `advanced` | Adam learning rate for VICReg training. | - |
| `projector_output_size` | `int` | `2048` | `advanced` | Width of each VICReg projection-head layer. | - |
| `max_patches` | `Optional[int]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional random cap on training/embedding patches for controlled smoke runs. | - |
